ideas.title: The Impact of the Federal Child Care Funding Freeze on Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the $10B federal child care funding freeze on Minnesota, including the number of families affected and potential solutions.
ideas.insight: The freeze may have significant implications for Minnesota families and the state's ability to provide child care services.

ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $3.2 million Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota, including the individuals involved and potential weaknesses in the system.
ideas.insight: The scheme highlights the need for increased oversight and enforcement in healthcare programs.
